message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Quick Reference)** | Section | Key Points | |---------|------------| | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in a hand and then scoring the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – match by color or number.
• **Action cards** – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four.
• **Wild cards** – can be played on any card; the player declares the next color. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends.
2. **Play** – Place a card that matches the top card of the discard pile by color, number, or symbol. If you have no playable card, you must draw. | | **Special Actions** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (two players: acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color and the next player draws four cards. Must be used only if the player has no matching color card; otherwise, the player can be challenged. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: the player who missed UNO must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Hand** | The first player to discard all cards wins the round. Score points equal to the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Variations & House Rules** | • Some groups play “Draw One” instead of “Draw Two.”
• “Wild Draw Four” may be played on any card if the player has no matching color.
• “Wild” can be played on any card, but the player must declare the next color. | **Tips for Beginners** 1. **Keep track of colors** – Try to hold onto a variety of colors so you’re not stuck with a single color when the discard pile changes. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save Wild Draw Four for when you’re about to win or when you need to force a big penalty on a strong opponent. 3. **Watch opponents’ cards** – If you see someone with many cards, try to play a Skip or Reverse to prevent them from getting rid of cards quickly. Enjoy playing Uno!
